## ⚡ Prime Master AI Plugin (`/prime`)

The workspace has been transformed into the **Prime Master AI Plugin**, integrating the entire collection of plugins, agents, and 3,000+ skills into a single installable package accessible via one master slash command:

```bash
/prime <task, instruction, or problem description>
```

- **Installable Package**: [dist/prime-plugin](file:///c:/Users/Tecno/Downloads/Prime/dist/prime-plugin)

- **Verified Compatibility**: Google Antigravity, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (39/39 automated validation checks passing).
